slides.headline: Search “[your brand] reviews”. What comes up first?
Often it's your Trustpilot page.
slides.body: For plenty of online brands, it outranks their own site for that search.

slides.headline: The score is right there in the result.
slides.body: Stars and a number, before anyone clicks.

slides.headline: That search happens right before they pay.
slides.body: “Is this brand legit?” is a checkout question.

slides.headline: Your own widgets show it too.
slides.body: If Trustpilot is embedded on your site, a drop shows on every product page.

slides.headline: One coordinated wave can move it.
slides.body: Especially when you have hundreds of reviews, not thousands.

slides.headline: More 5-stars won't bury it fast.
slides.body: But reviews that break Trustpilot's rules may be eligible for removal.

slides.headline: Save this. Run the same search again next month.
slides.sub: Spot a review that doesn't add up? DM the word REVIEW.
